content.value_statement: Large documents can become inconsistent when several writers work independently. This skill creates section tasks, tracks progress, and reviews work through VibeKanban.
actual_capabilities: Creates a document outline with section scopes and pending-content markers.
Defines self-contained VibeKanban tasks for individual document sections.
Delegates large sections into smaller tasks when a word limit is exceeded.
Monitors task status through todo, inprogress, inreview, and done states.
Reviews completed sections for accuracy, completeness, and consistent terminology.
Provides task templates for standard, technical, overview, utility, and security sections.
limitations: Requires a configured VibeKanban project for its full task-management workflow.
Does not write document sections directly; delegated writers create the content.
Cannot verify facts that are absent from the repository and supplied context.
Requires user review before final acceptance of the completed document.

use_cases.title: Plan an architecture document
use_cases.description: Create scoped tasks for an architecture document, then review each completed section for consistency.

use_cases.title: Coordinate product documentation
use_cases.description: Assign overview, setup, and reference sections to separate writers while tracking a shared delivery plan.

use_cases.title: Prepare a security design review
use_cases.description: Break security-model documentation into focused tasks covering protections, trust assumptions, and known limitations.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an outline for a deployment guide. Include section scopes and placeholders for content.

prompt_templates.title: Delegate document sections
prompt_templates.prompt: Break this design document outline into VibeKanban tasks. Give each task a clear scope, source files, and acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Monitor writing progress
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the document section tasks. Summarize their status and identify tasks that need review or follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Run a consistency review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review all completed sections of this technical document. Identify inconsistent terminology, missing cross-references, and duplicate content.

output_examples.input: Delegate an API design document to three writers.
output: Section tasks for overview, endpoint design, and error handling.
Each task includes scope, source references, and review criteria.
A status plan tracks tasks from todo through done.

output_examples.input: Review the completed sections for consistency.
output: A checklist of terminology and cross-reference issues.
Follow-up tasks for sections that need revision.
A completion decision after all issues are resolved.

best_practices: Give every section task a narrow scope and the required source references.
Use clear acceptance criteria before assigning a task to a writer.
Review terminology and cross-references after each approved section.
anti_patterns: Do not assign several writers overlapping sections without clear boundaries.
Do not approve a section before checking it against the referenced source files.
Do not mark the document complete while tasks remain pending or in review.

faq.question: Does this skill write document content?
faq.answer: No. It coordinates writers and reviews their completed sections.

faq.question: What task system does it use?
faq.answer: It uses VibeKanban tasks and workspace sessions when the project is configured.

faq.question: Can it handle a large technical document?
faq.answer: Yes. It divides the document into scoped sections and can create subtasks for large sections.

faq.question: How are completed sections reviewed?
faq.answer: The coordinator checks accuracy, completeness, formatting, terminology, and cross-references.

faq.question: What happens when a section needs revision?
faq.answer: The coordinator returns the task to inprogress with specific feedback.

faq.question: Can it work without configured VibeKanban repositories?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use a Task tool agent while VibeKanban tracks task status.
